en_title: Chainsaws 'Would Have Been Too Much' Even for GTA 6, as Rockstar Explains Why Some Extra Violent Weapons Are Missing
cn_title: 即便对《GTA 6》来说，电锯「也太过火了」：Rockstar解释为何部分格外暴力的武器缺席
opus_summary: 《GTA 6》中有枪械、棒球棒和坦克等武器，但系列作品中出现过的武士刀和电锯无法作为武器使用。Rockstar联合工作室负责人Rob Nelson表示，电锯并非因资源问题被排除，他认为以本作的画面分辨率和角色设定来看，使用电锯可能太过了。

paragraphs.en: You can commit an extreme amount of violence in GTA 6 , with a wide variety of weaponry. Guns, baseball bats, even tanks can be your chosen tool of destruction. But that hasn’t stopped some from wondering where some series favourites have disappeared to.
paragraphs.cn: 在《GTA 6》中，你可以使用种类繁多的武器大肆施暴。枪支、棒球棒，甚至坦克，都可以成为你选择的破坏工具。但这并未阻止一些人疑惑，系列中一些深受喜爱的武器究竟消失到哪里去了。

paragraphs.en: Among those are the likes of katanas and chainsaws, which were staples during Grand Theft Auto’s “3D universe” games, including Vice City and San Andreas. The chainsaw, in particular, holds a special connection to Vice City given its clear Scarface inspirations, and memorable scene involving the power tool from the 1983 movie.
paragraphs.cn: 其中包括武士刀和电锯，它们是《侠盗猎车手》「3D宇宙」时期游戏中的常见武器，包括《侠盗猎车手：罪恶都市》和《侠盗猎车手：圣安地列斯》。尤其是电锯，与《侠盗猎车手：罪恶都市》有着特殊联系，因为该游戏明显受到了《疤面煞星》的启发，而这部1983年的电影中有一个涉及这种电动工具的难忘场景。

paragraphs.en: But despite some being spotted around the latest version of Leonida in GTA 6, neither Jason nor Lucia can wield them as weapons. Why? Well, Rockstar co-studio head Rob Nelson explained the decision in an interview with VGC .
paragraphs.cn: 但尽管在《GTA 6》最新版本的Leonida各处能看到一些电锯，Jason和Lucia都无法将其当作武器使用。为什么呢？Rockstar联合工作室负责人Rob Nelson在接受VGC采访时解释了这一决定。

paragraphs.en: “As far as the chainsaw — I think it would have been too much for this game at this resolution and these characters,” Nelson says. "It’s not a resource thing. Even at the most psycho, did Jason and Lucia really need that — what’s that going to look like?”
paragraphs.cn: Nelson说：「至于电锯——我认为，以这款游戏的分辨率和这些角色而言，它会太过火了。这不是资源问题。即便是在最疯狂的情况下，Jason和Lucia真的需要那东西吗——那会是什么样子？」

paragraphs.en: When asked specifically about why chainsaws are lying about the world, but can’t be picked up, Nelson explained that, “you’re always trying to find what is the right sort of line and the right balance; it really just depends — you want to feel like you can interact with as much of the world as possible.”
paragraphs.cn: 当被具体问及为什么游戏世界中随处放着电锯，却无法捡起时，Nelson解释道：「你总是在努力寻找合适的界限和恰当的平衡；这确实要视情况而定——你希望感觉自己能与这个世界中的尽可能多的东西互动。」

paragraphs.en: I have to somewhat agree that it just wouldn’t feel like it fit either Jason or Lucia’s characters to be roaming around looking for limbs to chop off with a mechanised serrated blade. Ultimately, their story is one about committing crime to escape to a better, more “normal” life, not one about two psychopaths with a lust for blood going on a rampage.
paragraphs.cn: 我不得不在某种程度上表示赞同：四处游荡，用机械锯刃寻找可以砍下的肢体，感觉确实不符合Jason或Lucia的人物设定。归根结底，他们的故事讲的是通过犯罪逃向更好、更「正常」的生活，而不是两个嗜血的疯子大开杀戒的故事。

paragraphs.en: That being said, when whatever the online component of GTA 6 launches, I could see objects like this becoming weapons, allowing for people to roleplay as whatever brand of criminal, psychopath, or tree sculptor they wish. There’s a world of possibilities out there.
paragraphs.cn: 话虽如此，等到《GTA 6》的在线部分推出时，无论它会是什么形式，我认为这类物品有可能成为武器，让人们可以扮演自己想扮演的任何类型的罪犯、疯子或树木雕刻师。那里有着无穷的可能性。
